Class WorldEditorPane

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane
javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane
org.swarmforge.client.ui.WorldEditorPane
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class WorldEditorPane extends javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane
World Editor Pane for SwarmForge Studio. Features 3D, Top-Down, and Side synchronized views, manual 3D sculpting brushes, sub-millimeter voxel scale, soil substrates, micro-hydrology, planar water bodies, species-adapted world generator, and multi-LOD voxel scaling.
Author:
Silvère Martin-Michiellot, Gemini AI Assistant
